statement: The first line holds n and k; the second holds n integers. Print the kth largest element - the value that would sit at position k if the array were sorted descending. Keep a min-heap of at most k values while scanning: push each element, and pop the minimum whenever the size spills past k. After the scan the heap holds the k largest values, and its root is exactly the kth largest. Duplicates count separately: in 7 7 8, the 2nd largest is 7.

example.why: Sorted descending the array reads 6 5 4 3 2 1, and the second entry is 5.

hint: The heap's root is the weakest of the current champions - exactly the kth largest so far.
mistake: Keeping a max-heap of size k and evicting its maximum; that discards the champions and keeps the k smallest.
